script: Hi, it's Joe from WDI. We built a demo trade portal for Michael Quinlan Motors.
Garages and mechanics need parts fast, and they don't want to be on hold to get them.
With this, a garage logs in to its own trade account,
searches by part, sees its trade price and orders straight away.
Regular parts can be reordered in one click, and every order and invoice is there to check.
Your counter gets fewer calls, orders come in accurate, and your trade customers find it easier to buy from you than anyone else.

button:has-text('Place order'), button:has-text('Submit order'), button:has-text('Send order')
